remarks: Ratings to be confirmed by the fire protection concept
text: Fire protection of structural steel shall follow the fire resistance requirements of the Fire Regulation and NFPA 850 as determined in the fire protection concept (ALP-EPC-00000-HS-HAZ-0009): a minimum resistance of R 60 for the structures supporting or adjacent to LDO, gas station, transformers and the turbine hall and R 120 for the control and electrical building structure and for firewalls; passive fire protection shall be an intumescent coating compatible with the C5 system or concrete encasement.
